content: Dompa fikuk diniŋ yoyout mede
Heleniŋ me kadakaniŋ titiŋ hekidi Jesu medeŋiŋ nadine bugiŋ.
Kaŋ Falisi tiŋa Yodoko Mede hinale heki adi kaŋ nadikadaka tiŋa indiŋ yogiŋ, “Me yadi me kadakaniŋ titiŋ yehimaneeŋ yeniutumbalak.”
Unduŋ yogiŋ kaŋ Jesudi yoyout mede indiŋ yeniŋguk.
“Hidi’walaaniŋ nebek niŋdi binek dompa 100 yabudokoluwek ala kubugoŋ niŋ filune dediŋ tibek? Dompa 99 u deit tiiŋneŋ uŋgoŋ biyabuŋa noli u lohiyaugeyauge
kaŋ nagila kaluwaŋŋiŋ foloŋ kameeŋ nadifo tiŋa nagila buŋa yopmaŋ busuwawetik.
Busuwaaŋ noliŋiye mede kameyembu buune yenimbetik, ‘Nu dompane niŋ filak agaŋ tubumintaaŋ nadifo tilat doktiŋa hinaŋ wapum tinim.’”
Jesudi unduŋ yoŋa indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Indiŋ hanimbe nadineŋ. Me fofohi 99 aditok kunum gineŋ nadifo tiyemiiŋ iŋgoŋ me niŋ kadakaniŋ titiŋdi weleŋ tubutakalelak aditok adi nadifo loloŋnit hinek tiiŋ.”
Muneeŋ fikuk diniŋ yoyout mede
“Be tam niŋ adi 10 siliŋ boihatibek kaŋ kubugoŋ niŋ filek kaŋ tam u dediŋ tibek? Adi kamaŋ galiŋa yoli yohomuŋ tiŋa baigoŋ lohiŋa kaŋ tibetik.
Tiŋa noliŋiye yenimbune buune yenimbek, ‘Nu muneeŋne niŋ filak u agaŋ kaŋ tiŋat doktiŋa nadifo tilat ale hinaŋ tinim.’
“Undugoŋ hinek Bepaŋ’walaŋ aŋelo heki adi me kadakaniŋ titiŋ niŋdi weleŋ tubutakaleeŋ udanelak doktiŋa adi nadifo wapum tiiŋ.”
Mihi niŋ fikukneniŋ kotigoŋ udaneguk diniŋ yoyout mede
Unduŋ yoŋa tomboyoula indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Me niŋ hatiluguk adi mihiŋiyat lufomuk.
Ala Moneŋiŋdi beu indiŋ niŋguk, ‘Me baŋ, bomboŋ nutok u kamiŋ danenambeŋ.’
Unduŋ nimbune danemiŋguk, kaŋ muniniŋ hatiŋa muneeŋ bomboŋŋiŋ moŋgola yokwet bikabuŋa uguk. Kwet niŋkade kweetniŋ hinek wooŋ, muneeŋŋiŋ nadi mu tiŋa kaka hinek kudapmaguk.
“Kaŋ nai uŋaniŋ nanaŋe map wapum hinek mintaguk kaŋ adi nanaŋenit mokit, hogok hatifit tuguk.
Unduŋ doktiŋa me uŋaniŋ niŋ wooŋ kaune tipilapilaye kwanai titiŋdok yoŋa niŋkulune wooŋ makaye nanaŋe yemyem tuluguk.
Uŋoŋ wooŋ makaye nanaŋe uŋakoŋ fiit nawit nadiŋa uguk. Iŋgoŋ u maaŋ kamehep timiŋgiŋ.
“Unduŋ timimbune hanadikunakunale-tauyeŋ indiŋ naditomguk, ‘Batne’walaŋ kwanai-me hogohogok adi nanaŋe wapum hinek naiŋ, kaŋ nu mihiŋiŋ hinekdi iŋoŋ map kisaŋ hinek tilat.
Unduŋ doktiŋa pilali batne’walaŋ wooŋ indiŋ nimbit, “O me baŋ, nu Bepaŋ sigilulum timiŋgut tiŋa du maaŋ sigilulum tigamuŋa kadakaniŋ tugut
doktiŋa nu du mihige hinek kotigoŋ mu nanimbu hatiluwaat. Kwanai mege hogok nanimbu hatiluwaat.”’
Unduŋ yoŋa pilali beu kawe uguk. “Wooŋ yot tubudulalune beudi kaguk, kaŋ weleŋ goloune bulaniŋgoŋ hinek nadiŋa kiyaneeŋ wooŋ toboŋa siŋgoŋgome tuguk.
Kaŋ mihiŋiŋdi yoguk, ‘Me baŋ, nu Bepaŋ be du hidi sigilulum tihamuŋa kadakaniŋ tugut doktiŋa nu du mihige hinek kotigoŋ mu nanimbu hatiluwaat.’
“Unduŋ niŋguk iŋgoŋ beu adi tipilapilaye mihiŋiye yeniŋguk, ‘Pilap hinek wooŋ dahidahi fofooŋ niŋ tineŋ, haluntuk niŋ tineŋ eŋ kayoŋnamokop moŋgotneŋ. Unduŋ moŋgola buŋa tinahukulimineŋ.
Tiŋa wooŋ makau mihiniŋ folooŋnit hinek uŋak ulune hinaŋ wapum tinim.
Mihine i agaŋ kumuŋgukneniŋ udanelak, tiŋa agaŋ fikuk iŋgoŋ tubumintayam doktiŋa hinaŋ tinim.’ Unduŋ yoŋa hinaŋ tububihikiŋ.
“Unduŋ ha-tulune Tuwo adi kade gineŋ hatiguk ala udaneeŋ buŋa yot tubudulaaŋ nadilune kap miyeeŋ tonadifo tigiŋ.
Nadiŋa tipilapilaye-me niŋ katinimbu uune niŋguk, ‘U maŋgoŋ tiŋa toiŋ?’
“Unduŋ nimbune yoguk, ‘Kwayage koti kulemaŋgoŋ udaneeŋ buŋak kaŋ bahadi wendoktiŋa nadifooŋ makau mihiniŋ folooŋnit ulaŋa helak.’
“Unduŋ nimbune nadiŋa kwihita tiŋa yot maaneŋ mu foune beudi buŋa yot maaneŋ fofoŋdok niŋkulemaguk. Kaŋ mihiŋiŋdi weleŋ kudup daune niŋguk,

‘I kaweŋ, nu guletgulet hatitabam hogohogok adi me kwanai tuwaŋit mokit adi tiiŋ dabugoŋ tigamulat. Tiŋa mede wobu nemu tigamulat iŋgoŋ du meme bedikwambundaaŋ kabe nemu nambune notneye dut hina nadifo tugumun.
Iŋgoŋ mihigedi bomboŋge moŋgo wooŋ talitam heki dut hatiŋa tubudapmaaŋ buŋak kaŋ makau mihiniŋ folooŋnit hinek ula hinaŋ ya nadifo toiŋ.’
“Unduŋ yobune beudi indiŋ niŋguk, ‘Mihine, du adi helemahelemaŋ nukut iŋgoŋ hatilaŋ doktiŋa nemenemek hogohogok u dutok.
Kaŋ kwayage adi agaŋ kumuŋgukneŋniŋ udaneŋak be fikukneniŋ tubumintayam doktiŋa hinaŋ wapum tiŋa nadifo tinene utumbawek.’”
